stakeholders.name: Social Welfare Department (社會福利署)
stakeholders.role: Governing authority responsible for overseeing and coordinating welfare and protection services related to elder abuse cases.

stakeholders.name: Hospital Authority (醫院管理局)
stakeholders.role: Oversees public hospitals, approves disclosure of patient data, and supports clinical intervention and protection in abuse cases.

stakeholders.name: Equal Opportunities Commission
stakeholders.role: Promotes and monitors equal opportunity, including issues concerning age discrimination and elderly rights.

original_names: Equal Opportunities Commission (EOC) (平等機會委員會)

stakeholders.name: Social Workers
stakeholders.role: Frontline professionals responsible for intake, case management, assessment, coordination of services, and follow-up for suspected elder abuse cases.

stakeholders.name: Multi-disciplinary Case Conference (多專業個案會議)
stakeholders.role: Collaborative platform involving professionals from various disciplines for assessment and decision-making regarding elder abuse.

stakeholders.name: Elderly Persons (長者)
stakeholders.role: Primary recipients and potential victims of services and interventions; includes the physically/mentally frail or disabled.

stakeholders.name: Suspected Perpetrators (疑似施虐者)
stakeholders.role: Individuals (often caregivers, family members, or staff) suspected of committing abuse against elderly persons.

stakeholders.name: Family Members/Caregivers (家人/照顧者)
stakeholders.role: Direct providers of care and support to elderly persons; may be at risk of perpetrating or preventing abuse; often involved in case conferences.

stakeholders.name: Hong Kong Police Force (香港警務處)
stakeholders.role: Law enforcement body involved in criminal investigation and immediate safety protection of elder abuse cases.

stakeholders.name: Medical Practitioners (including Psychiatrists, Geriatricians, etc.)
stakeholders.role: Provide health assessment, evaluation of mental capacity, injury examination, and medical care for the elderly in abuse cases.

stakeholders.name: NGOs Providing Elder Services (安老服務機構)
stakeholders.role: Non-governmental organizations offering elderly care, community support, and reporting suspected abuse.

stakeholders.name: Residential Care Homes for the Elderly (安老院舍)
stakeholders.role: Institutions providing residential and nursing care to elderly persons, and sites where abuse may occur and be reported.

stakeholders.name: Multi-disciplinary Support Centers (多專業支援中心)
stakeholders.role: Facilities providing urgent intervention and support services, including crisis intervention, for abused elders.

stakeholders.name: Legal Sector (法律界)
stakeholders.role: Provide legal opinions, assistance with guardianship orders, and support in handling criminal cases related to elder abuse.

stakeholders.name: Guardianship Board (監護委員會)
stakeholders.role: Authority for issuing guardianship orders, critical in protecting incapacitated elders.

stakeholders.name: GovHK
stakeholders.role: Hong Kong SAR Government, responsible for overarching policy, budget allocation, and coordination of elderly care, healthcare, and welfare systems.

stakeholders.name: Labour and Welfare Bureau
stakeholders.role: Formulates and implements policies on labour, manpower development, social welfare, and elderly financial assistance in Hong Kong.

stakeholders.name: Food and Health Bureau
stakeholders.role: Oversees health policies, healthcare provision, and schemes such as the Elderly Health Care Voucher Scheme.

stakeholders.name: Elderly Commission
stakeholders.role: Advisory body to the government, providing strategic guidance and policy input on elderly services.

stakeholders.name: Community Care Fund
stakeholders.role: Provides funding for pilot schemes and initiatives to support community-based elderly programs.

stakeholders.name: Hong Kong Social Service Federation (香港社會服務聯會)
stakeholders.role: Umbrella NGO coordinating and advocating for social service provision, including elderly and healthcare services.

stakeholders.name: Hong Kong Community Organizations Association (香港社區組織協會)
stakeholders.role: Local community-based NGO, advocates for elderly rights, primary healthcare, and social services.

stakeholders.name: Elderly (General Population Group)
stakeholders.role: Primary recipients and users of elderly care, healthcare, financial support, and related services.

stakeholders.name: Residential Care Service Providers
stakeholders.role: Organizations running residential care homes—provide long-term stay, daily living, and healthcare support for the elderly.

stakeholders.name: Department of Health
stakeholders.role: Formulates and implements public health measures and reports, monitors elderly health outcomes.

stakeholders.name: Hospital Authority Staff
stakeholders.role: Frontline professionals delivering health services to elderly patients in public hospitals.

stakeholders.name: Census and Statistics Department
stakeholders.role: Collects and disseminates demographic data, supporting policy decisions on ageing and elderly care.

stakeholders.name: CUHK Jockey Club Institute of Ageing
stakeholders.role: Academic institute conducting research and developing indicators on elderly quality of life and age-related policy issues.

stakeholders.name: World Health Organization
stakeholders.role: Provides international policy frameworks, research, and recommendations on ageing, health, and social support.

stakeholders.name: Hong Kong Housing Authority
stakeholders.role: Allocates and manages public rental housing, including special consideration for elderly applicants.

stakeholders.name: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government (香港特別行政區政府)
stakeholders.role: Sets and enforces labor policy, leads on anti-discrimination law, manages civil service retirement age.

stakeholders.role: Shape, debate, and vote on employment/anti-discrimination legislation, reflect public and sector views.
